reviews.title: Absolute BS
reviews.text: This app is so scummy. It demands that you enroll in a paid subscription immediately and promises a high payout, before you even see the rest of the app. Attempting to delete the app then magically manifests a free 3-day trial and discounted subscription that was mysteriously not presented as an option when they first showed the subscription plans. I engaged with the free trial, and then checked all of the "no proof required" options - and, EVERY SINGLE ONE required very extensive proof and a previous existing claim number. Not a single one of the recommended claims even applied to me. This app is just a cash grab disguised as something to help the average struggling consumer. The developer should be arrested for fraud!
